title: AOT Routing
content:
Photon utilizes Ahead-of-Time compilation for route matching. This eliminates the need for expensive tree traversal at runtime.

Dynamic Segments

Define parameters with colons and retrieve them directly via the context:

app.get('/user/:id', (c) => {
  const id = c.req.param('id')
  return c.text('Authorized access: ' + id)
})

Route Priorities

  • Static Paths: O(1) matching via Hash Map.
  • Parametric Paths: Optimized Radix Tree matching.
  • Wildcards: Fallback catch-all patterns.
